blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Sen. Antonio Trillanes IV’s allegation that a food company owned by lawyer Manases Carpio, husband of Vice President Sara Duterte, received more than P319 million from China has gained credence after a government official confirmed the transaction. At Duterte’s impeachment trial on Monday, counsel for the prosecution Mae Divinagracia asked Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) Executive Director Ronel Buenaventura about the total amount of inward financial transactions involving Carpio’s CALE88 Foods Corp., or money that came from mainland China and Hong Kong to the said company.
